_readme: Expectation checklist, the common base (PDF2BIM_VECTOR_PROBE.md §49 / §50): if the set shows X, Y must exist. Data, read by type_expect.py (scan side) and, later, by the Modeller's qualifier. 'when' is a comparison over READ facts; 'evidence' names where a value may come from, in order; 'check' entries are evaluated by name in type_expect.py (one function each, cited). A rule never fills a body: MISSING is a stated finding.

look.lower_plan: tread lines inside a closed outline
look.upper_plan: the same outline with the walk line and the arrival arrow
look.label: <n> STG <rise cm>/<going cm>
